Landing is negotiated on the sand, and these islands have not asked the Chain Council for help against Grung pressure. [[Halewick]] is the ordinary fishing island temporarily ruled by Toby and Frankie; [[Blackrule]] is a Tyr chapterhouse; [[Slackwater]] is the shared harbour. Compact index: [[ket-solane]] (smugglers' caves); [[Feyroa]] (secret-taking distillery); [[Ossira]] (seabird rookery); [[Palutai]] (reef feud); [[Ravasol]] (stilt village); [[sable-roost]] (sky-pirate wrecks); [[Sanvashti]] (Grung truce); [[sump-cradle]] (healing mud); [[hollow-choir|The Hollow Choir]] (harmonic tide caves); [[Twineye]] (fighting families); [[velk-ithera]] (sound-sensitive fungal hill).
